dedupe_keys.name: traffic analysis zone based human mobility data coming from mobile phone data

description: traffic analysis zone based human mobility data coming from mobile phone data is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors zheng zhang. we extract human trips from Call Records Detail data. Combining traffic analysis zone dataset, we map each trip record to the zones with the same origin zones and destination zones. After this, we can obtain this dataset. This dataset stores the hourly number of departure and arrival trips in each traffic analysis zone. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
